# Appverse

> Appverse (https://appverse.lol) runs small apps: single `.applet` files (zip archives of plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript plus a `manifest.json`) that run in a sandboxed, network-less iframe in the visitor's browser. It is the apps sibling of Gameverse (https://gameverse.lol).

If you are an AI agent asked to make an Appverse app, write a self-contained static web app (no network, no external URLs, no CSP of your own), add a `manifest.json`, and hand back the files.

Status: draft. Tools (Node 20+, no install), from the "Download the tools" button on https://appverse.lol/make.html (a zip): `node tools/applet.mjs new <name>` starts an app from a template; `check` finds mistakes (network use, missing files, missing permissions); `pack` builds the .applet; `dev` runs it in the sandbox and reloads on save; `inspect` and `unpack` open a package.

## Start here

- [Make an app](https://appverse.lol/make.html): folder layout, manifest, storage bridge, what does not work.
- [Specification](https://appverse.lol/spec.html): manifest fields, permissions, sandbox and CSP rules.

## Tools and templates

- [Starter app](https://appverse.lol/templates/starter/index.html): `index.html`, `app.js`, `style.css` and [manifest.json](https://appverse.lol/templates/starter/manifest.json) of a working app.
- [Example: Notes](https://appverse.lol/examples/notes/index.html), which uses the storage and clipboard bridge.
- [AGENTS.md](https://appverse.lol/templates/starter/AGENTS.md): the rules in one page.
